name: std::feraiseexcept
intro: Attempts to raise all floating point exceptions listed in excepts (a bitwise OR of the floating point exception macros). If one of the exceptions is FE_OVERFLOW or FE_UNDERFLOW, this function may additionally raise FE_INEXACT. The order in which the exceptions are raised is unspecified, except that FE_OVERFLOW and FE_UNDERFLOW are always raised before FE_INEXACT.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
excepts

 -

 bitmask listing the exception flags to raise

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 0 if all listed exceptions were raised, non-zero value otherwise.

examples.output:
Raising divbyzero and underflow simultaneously succeeds and results in
division by zero
underflow
